title: Race three solvers, then straighten a flow
brief: Build Euler, midpoint, and RK4 and measure their convergence orders, a minibatch optimal-transport pairing, and a straightness measure that shows what one round of reflow does.
hints: Compute each step's start time as k / n_steps rather than adding dt repeatedly, so the last step ends on t = 1 exactly.
Midpoint evaluates the field at x + (h/2) k1 and time t + h/2. RK4 combines four slopes with weights 1, 2, 2, 1, divided by 6.
scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment on the (n, n) matrix of squared distances returns (rows, cols); cols is the permutation.
straightness runs Euler, keeps every velocity, and averages the squared norm of (z1 - z0) - v over steps and samples. Sum over the feature axis before averaging over samples.
